## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (a bug fix has a test that failed before)
- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `.env.example`, `docs/`) if behaviour or settings changed
- [ ] New settings are editable in the web UI and scriptable (`glucava config`) or seedable from the environment
- [ ] No secrets, real glucose data or real account details in code, tests, logs, screenshots or this description
